I've learned so much about South Korea through the years by watching your channel so I'm excited for the new content!

We decided to take our kids off of our social media 2 years ago. Not only is it nice to have privacy for the family, but the world is weird now. People will use AI to exploit kids and families. I totally respect you and your decision. You are a great wife and mom.

I followed you well before you got married and had kids. I completely respect not wanting to film family vlogs anymore. Using children as money makers is a huge problem that is still not addressed worldwide. I'm sure it'll be nice to have a little time capsule of their first few years of life either way <3 Looking forward to new content!
I'm so glad you're teaching the kids critical songs that they need to know. Backstreet's back ALRIGHT!
